address: 3F, Grand Mayfull Hotel, 55 Lequn 2nd Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 10462, Taiwan
bio: The former head chef has been promoted to executive chef and the kitchen is now helmed by his long-standing protégé. Rest assured that the menu has not changed and is as meticulously crafted as ever. The signature dish, stewed Chinese cabbage with fish skin, is topped with a fried crunchy garnish made with duck eggs from Yilan, while the honey mustard-glazed ribs exude tangy fruitiness thanks to black jujube dates in the sauce.
